high_level_description: The image showcases an exquisite piece of jewelry, specifically a high-end snake-themed necklace displayed on a mannequin bust. The necklace is intricately designed with a combination of green gemstones and sparkling diamonds. The green gemstones, likely emeralds, are set into the scales of the snake, creating a vibrant contrast against the white diamonds that outline the body and add to the intricate detailing. The snake's head is prominently featured at the center of the necklace, with its mouth open, revealing a large, prominent green gemstone that serves as the eye.
